name: shw-plugins
description: Product lifecycle workflow with product truth, version planning, Issue delivery, release, Fleet observability, engineering standards, and Gitea integration.

worktree_root.title: Worktree root
worktree_root.description: 可选：插件工作区统一绝对路径；留空读取用户级 worktree.json 或默认用户数据目录

gitea_host.title: Gitea host
gitea_host.description: 你的 Gitea 实例地址（含协议头，如 https://gitea.example.com）

gitea_token.title: Gitea token
gitea_token.description: Gitea API token（Gitea Web → Settings → Applications 创建，scope 按需勾选）

k8s_mcp_url.title: Kubernetes MCP URL
k8s_mcp_url.description: 统一只读 Kubernetes MCP 的 HTTPS Streamable HTTP 地址（通常以 /mcp 结尾）

k8s_mcp_token.title: Kubernetes MCP token
k8s_mcp_token.description: 由基础设施侧按 Agent 签发的 Kubernetes MCP Bearer token；不得填 kubeconfig 或 Rancher token
